exposure: timing of cholecystectomy after acute severe pancreatitis
cohort: A single pregnant patient who experienced acute severe pancreatitis at 27 weeks gestation, leading to termination of pregnancy, and subsequently underwent cholecystectomy due to relapse.
finding: The timing of cholecystectomy after severe pancreatitis in pregnancy may need re-evaluation, as the present case demonstrates that pancreatitis can relapse within the currently suggested interval.
